name: Tracy Good
occupation: Natrona County clerk (re-elected November 2026). Oil City News reported that she told a July 8, 2026, forum she was seeking a third term and had worked in the office for 32 years.
prior_offices: Natrona County clerk (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026; Oil City News reported she said she was seeking a third term)
background: Tracy Good is the Natrona County clerk and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. Oil City News reported that at a July 8, 2026, Politics in the Park forum she said she was seeking a third term, had worked in the office for 32 years, and described the clerk as custodian of official county records, with duties that include preparing and maintaining the county budget, processing vehicle titles, and running elections.
